facts.fact: Ecofin Agency, citing the International Telecommunication Union, says a 5 GB mobile data package cost the equivalent of 7.36% of gross national income per capita in the Comoros in 2025.
Ecofin Agency reports that state-owned Comores Telecom offers 40 GB for 20,000 Comorian francs.
Ecofin Agency reports that Yas Telecom markets an unlimited plan including 50 GB for 25,000 Comorian francs, about USD 58.

note: Plan validity period is not stated; taken as monthly packages.
